🕵️ Shadow Trader Digest – 30 August 2026


Three under-the-radar events that might quietly move markets this week:



  1. 🇦🇺 Monetary policy decision
    Tuesday, 01 September · RBA
    Board cash-rate call; the statement's tightening bias is what FX hedges reprice.
    Source →

  2. 🇨🇳 Margin and circuit-breaker parameter update
    Tuesday, 01 September · Shanghai Stock Exchange
    New collateral rules effective for program accounts; broker risk engines re-jiggered overnight.
    Source →

  3. 🌐 ICC arbitration calendar — Q4 hearing schedule
    Wednesday, 02 September · Community
    Dispute-resolution calendar used by commodities desks; hearing gaps hint at case-flow delays.
    Source →


Stay hidden. Stay ahead.
— Goldirham Whisper
